target: two sequential hidden STATIC HWNDs created by this probe on one thread
actions: read native owner identity and production target_generation
destroy first HWND and confirm IsWindow false
create second hidden HWND on same thread
read native owner identity and production target_generation
destroy second HWND and confirm IsWindow false
retry_policy: one attempt; retain non-reuse as inconclusive; no retry
discriminator: If numeric HWND, PID, GUI-thread ID, and process creation time all match and target_generation is equal, record a demonstrated generation alias across HWND destruction/recreation.
